display.purpose: The single hero headline in the Note node.

headline-section.purpose: A page section that holds groups (Install).

headline.purpose: Each step's heading beside its node.

title-doc.purpose: Headings inside a long document node.

body-large.purpose: Step copy beside a node, max 46ch.

label.purpose: Pills, widget rows, tags, captions, meta.

port.purpose: Port labels: UPPERCASE outputs, lowercase inputs.

shadows.name: shadow-node
shadows.purpose: Every node; nothing else casts a shadow.

shadows.name: shadow-node-soft
shadows.purpose: The float part of the missing ring.

shadows.name: missing-ring
shadows.purpose: A node whose model is missing; replaces shadow-node.

shadows.name: pin-halo
shadows.purpose: Separates a pin from the node edge it overhangs.

shadows.name: toggle-glass
shadows.purpose: The media toggle over moving video; no blur.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 2px solid var(--link); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--r-widget)

shadows.name: shot-fade-right
shadows.purpose: A wide screenshot that runs past its node fades out on the right.

motion.name: wire-draw
motion.purpose: A flow wire draws when its target node rises into view.

motion.name: reveal-fade
motion.purpose: The sample output image appearing once the workflow runs.

motion.name: progress-ease
motion.purpose: Scripted download and sampler progress bars.

motion.name: video-loop

motion.name: reduced-motion

narrative.overview:
The suite's web presence looks like the place its users already work: a ComfyUI graph on a charcoal canvas with a faint dot grid. Content lives in nodes (a darker title bar with a coloured dot, a body of ports and widget rows) and nodes are joined by wires that leave an output pin on the right and arrive at an input pin on the left. The world is inherited, not invented: Model Librarian Gallery's charcoal "Darkroom" neutrals, Segoe UI Variable, Model Librarian's blue for actions and its status pills.

Density is the apps' density: small labels, hairline borders, tight widget rows, generous space only between nodes. Colour is functional. Neutrals carry everything; blue means "do this"; red, amber and green mean model status; and the saturated slot colours belong to wires, pins and node dots, where they encode data type exactly as ComfyUI does. Real screenshots and recordings sit inside nodes as their bodies, so the product's own UI is the imagery.

The page is dark only, by decision: it mirrors the apps, which are dark, and declares `color-scheme: dark` with a canvas-coloured theme colour. There is no light theme to keep in step.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal canvas (dot grid every 24px) with flat grey nodes floating on a soft ambient shadow.
Node anatomy: title bar with a coloured dot, optional tag or pill at the right, ports row, widget rows or a screenshot body.
Wires coloured by ComfyUI slot type, drawn as horizontal-tangent bezier curves between same-typed pins.
One action colour (blue) and three status colours (red, amber, green), never used decoratively.
Every colour and radius the page uses is a named custom property on `:root`; components reference names, never literals.
Segoe UI Variable throughout, with the Display optical size for headings. Dark only.

rules.name: The Slot Colour Rule
rules.body: Wire colour is the ComfyUI slot type of the pins it joins, and a wire only ever joins an output and an input of the same type. Never colour a wire by section, brand or mood.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and green mean Missing, Moved and OK. They appear only where a model's state is being shown. A status pill in a node's title bar keeps its status colour; only plain tags there go Dim.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Blue fills only the next action (primary button, current tab) and download progress. Neutral buttons stay grey.

rules.name: The Named Colour Rule
rules.body: Every colour on the page is a `:root` custom property. A new colour is a new named token, not a literal in a rule or an inline style.

rules.name: The Derived Group Rule
rules.body: An install group frame has one hue, its part's wire token (Model Librarian is w-model, Chrome is w-image, Gallery is w-library). Its border is that hue at 55% over transparent, its body that hue mixed 7% into Node Grey, its header 22% into Node Grey (`color-mix(in srgb, …)`). Those three colours are derived, never separate tokens.

rules.name: The App Voice Rule
rules.body: Inside a node, type is app-sized (0.75 to 0.9375rem). Large type exists only outside nodes or in the Note node's headline.

rules.name: The Touch Target Rule
rules.body: Below 720px every button (small ones included), the media toggle, each top-bar tab, the brand link and each footer link is at least 44px tall. On desktop buttons stay 40px and small buttons 32px.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: Nodes float; their contents do not. Depth inside a node comes from the inset tone, never a second shadow.

dos: **Do** put content in nodes with a title bar, a coloured dot and real ports, and join them with wires between same-typed pins.
**Do** label outputs with UPPERCASE type names and inputs with lowercase slot names.
**Do** use the real app screenshots and recordings as node bodies, labelled as sample data, with narrow crops for phones.
**Do** keep blue for the next action and download progress, and red, amber, green for model status only.
**Do** name every new colour and radius as a `:root` token, and set hues with classes.
**Do** give every control a 44px target below 720px.
**Do** honour prefers-reduced-motion: wires appear without drawing, demos jump to their end state, videos show controls instead of autoplaying.
donts: **Don't** colour a wire by anything but its ComfyUI slot type, or join two different types.
**Don't** add a second shadow, glow or gradient inside a node; depth inside is tonal.
**Don't** use the base-model badge colours on wires or dots; they belong to model tags inside the app screenshots.
**Don't** fill neutral buttons with blue, or use status colours as decoration.
**Don't** set large type inside a node, except the Note node's headline.
**Don't** add a radius outside the named scale, a colour literal outside `:root`, or a hue in an inline style.
**Don't** add a light theme; the page is dark like the apps.
